data.conventions_summary: This is the FastAPI Python repository, built on the Starlette framework and managed with uv. The top-level directories include docs and docs_src for documentation, the core fastapi package, plus tests and scripts, suggesting distinct areas for source code, tests, documentation, and tooling. Tests are run with pytest, and both linting and formatting are enforced by ruff, so contributors should make sure ruff checks pass. Continuous integration uses GitHub Actions, though the specific workflow jobs were not detected in the scan. You should run the pytest suite and let ruff handle formatting and linting before proposing changes.
